reason: Here पूँछ बुझाइ = having put out (the fire on) the tail; बुझाना 'extinguish' sense is missing.
जरा न सो = he did not burn; past tense of जरना (जलना). The 'old age' sense does not fit this line.
देहिं सब तारी = all clap their hands; तारी here is ताली (clap).
बाँधे कइ लाजा = shame of being bound; 'built' is wrong.
दीजे कछु चीन्हा = give some token; here a noun (चिह्न), not the verb.
Subject is masculine singular (सठ … लइ आइहि = the fool will bring); feminine plural आएँगी is wrong.
बान प्रताप प्रभुहि समुझाएहु = remind the Lord of his arrow's might; 'console' does not fit.
